name: Yingtao Kezhan
source: You come at your grandmother's behest, expecting only to see the place she guarded all her life. A gentle innkeeper. A bubbly young girl. A fiery, mysterious woman. Three meals, small talk, days so quiet they feel like a slow dream. Then, past one midnight, it hits you—this inn has never sheltered only travelers.
translation: 你奉外婆之命来到此地，本以为只是来看看她穷尽一生守护的地方。温和的掌柜，活泼的少女，风风火火的神秘女子。一日三餐，闲话家常，日子安静得宛如一场悠长的慢梦。直到某个午夜过后，你猛然惊觉——这座客栈自古以来收留的，从来都不只是过路旅人。
